title: 021 掌握大招022 阴差再现多追读
content_zh:
连续三天，许临东都沉浸在家中修炼。
两瓶三级超凡药剂尽数吸收炼化，加上通天塔内的勤修不辍，使得他的精气神一路拔升到了48.7的程度。
三级药剂效果确实霸道，足足为他提升了接近9点的精气神，抵得上他苦修十多日的成果。
只是若算一笔账，单瓶三级药剂市价超过三万，两瓶六万多，却只换来节省十来天时间。
这般“性价比”
在外人看来，或许并不划算。
但这也是愈发凸显出通天塔的逆天之处。
“在塔内修炼，几乎等同于我每天都在服用四级药剂……一旦离开塔，我的修炼速度便会骤降七倍。”
“超凡药剂虽能提速，但从效率看，对我而言并不合算。
可对常人来说，它却能节省数倍时间，仍是珍贵资源。”
屋内，许临东感受着体内奔涌的超凡力量，心中并无半分浪费之感。
消耗在自己身上，怎么能叫浪费，至少实力是提升了。
伴随精气神提升的，是他体内那一股不断凝聚壮大的超凡力量。
若是用武侠小说的说法通俗比喻，修炼精气神所诞生的超凡力量，就好比内力。
而序列赋予的不同能力，则如不同的武功招式。
内力越浑厚，招式便越凌厉，施展起来也越发持久。
“以我现在的实力，再施展灶神降临，成功率应当能提高不少……”
念头一转，许临东意识再度沉入通天塔。
天道房间内，他屏息凝神，反复催动灶神降临。
一连七次尝试，火焰都是未能完美成形。

直到第八次......
轰！
赤红灶火自许临东周身猛然爆发，焰光冲天而起，将他整个人彻底笼罩。
他的双眼在那一瞬燃起灼灼金红，发丝根根倒竖，仿佛由纯粹火焰凝聚而成，随热流剧烈跃动，宛如一尊自灶膛中踏出的火中之神。
天道房间顿时被映得一片通明，热浪翻涌。
体内超凡力量被急速抽空。
可置身于这狂暴烈焰之中，许临东只觉举手投足皆能牵引炽流。
强大的守护之力与灼热威势合二为一，仿佛化身执掌灶火的神祇。
一股强烈的激动与振奋顿时从他心底升起。
“终于成了……即便还不熟练，只要日后多加巩固便好。”
他双眼兴奋。
能娴熟掌握这一式，往后即便再陷入曾经那般凶险的邪异物场域，他也将拥有更强的自保之力。
不过此时，消耗过巨，他难以维持状态太久，很快便退出通天塔。
在房间里调息了两个多小时后，恢复了不少超凡力量。
许临东瞥了眼手机时间。
已经是周六下午四点。
他这才想起，今晚正是卢倩在东星大酒店设宴庆功的日子。
“差点修炼过头，差点把正事忘了。”
许临东立即起身，快步走进浴室洗漱，换上一身利落衣物，准备出门。
“关在家里几天，一出来就洗澡穿这么精神，”

易千浔贴着面膜从对面房间走出来，瞥了他一眼，“准备去约会啊？”
家里此时也没旁人，她这几天也早感应到许临东闭门修炼，气息明显强了不少。
许临东回头一笑，“队里庆功宴，卢队请客，在东星酒店，吃完就回。”
“行，少喝点，我可不想半夜伺候醉鬼。”
易千浔懒洋洋窝进沙发，翻起漫画，目光却悄悄追着他背影，补了一句，“你给的那两瓶超凡药剂我喝完了，昨天在所里测过，精气神到18了。”
content_en:
For three consecutive days, Xu Lindong was immersed in practicing at home.
After absorbing and refining all the two bottles of level 3 extraordinary potions, coupled with the diligent cultivation in the Babel Tower, his energy level rose all the way to 48.7.
The effect of the third-level potion was indeed overbearing, boosting his energy level by nearly 9 points, which was worth the results of more than ten days of hard training.
But if you calculate the total, the market price of a single bottle of level 3 medicine is more than 30,000 yuan, and two bottles are more than 60,000 yuan, but it only saves about ten days of time.
Such "value for money"
In the eyes of outsiders, it may not be cost-effective.
But this also increasingly highlights the unparalleled aspects of the Tower of Babel.
"Cultivation in the tower is almost equivalent to me taking level four potions every day... Once I leave the tower, my cultivation speed will drop seven times."
“Although the extraordinary potion can increase the speed, in terms of efficiency, it is not cost-effective for me.
But for ordinary people, it can save several times time and is still a precious resource. "
Inside the room, Xu Lindong felt the extraordinary power rushing through his body, and he didn't feel any waste in his heart.
How can it be called a waste if it is consumed on oneself? At least the strength has been improved.
Accompanying the improvement in energy and spirit was the extraordinary power within his body that was constantly gathering and growing.
To use a popular metaphor from martial arts novels, the extraordinary power born from cultivating essence, energy, and spirit is like internal strength.
The different abilities given by the sequence are like different martial arts moves.
The stronger the inner strength, the more powerful the moves will be, and the longer they will last.
"With my current strength, if I use the Kitchen God's Advent again, the success rate should be improved a lot..."
As soon as his thoughts changed, Xu Lindong's consciousness sank into the Babel Tower again.
In the Tiandao room, he held his breath and concentrated, repeatedly urging the Kitchen God to come.
After seven consecutive attempts, the flame failed to form perfectly.
Until the eighth time...
Boom!
The red stove fire suddenly erupted from Xu Lindong's body, and the flames shot up into the sky, completely covering his whole body.
His eyes burned a blazing golden red at that moment, and his hair stood on end, as if made of pure flames, leaping violently with the heat, like a god of fire stepping out of the stove.
The Tiandao room was suddenly illuminated and filled with heat.
The extraordinary power in his body was quickly drained.
But being in this violent flame, Xu Lindong felt that he could pull the blazing stream with every move he made.
The powerful protective power and the scorching power are combined into one, as if they are the gods in charge of the stove fire.
A strong excitement and excitement suddenly rose from the bottom of his heart.
"It's finally done... Even if I'm not proficient yet, I just need to consolidate it more in the future."
His eyes were excited.
If he can master this technique skillfully, he will have a stronger ability to protect himself even if he falls into the dangerous evil field again.
However, at this time, the consumption was too huge, and he could not maintain his condition for too long, and soon exited the Tower of Babel.
After adjusting my breath in the room for more than two hours, I regained a lot of extraordinary strength.
Xu Lindong glanced at the time on his phone.
It's already four o'clock on Saturday afternoon.
Only then did he remember that tonight was the day when Lu Qian was hosting a banquet at the East Star Hotel to celebrate her success.
"I almost practiced too much and almost forgot about the real thing."
Xu Lindong stood up immediately, walked quickly into the bathroom to wash up, put on neat clothes, and was ready to go out.
"I'll be locked up at home for a few days, and when I come out, I'll take a shower and dress so energetic,"
Yi Qianxun walked out of the opposite room wearing a facial mask and glanced at him, "Are you ready to go on a date?"
There was no one else at home at this time, and she had sensed that Xu Lindong was practicing behind closed doors in the past few days, and his aura was obviously much stronger.
Xu Lindong turned around and smiled, "The team is having a celebration banquet. Team Lu is treating us at the East Star Hotel. We will go back after eating."
"Okay, drink less, I don't want to wait for a drunk in the middle of the night."
Yi Qianxun lazily settled into the sofa, flipping through the comics, but his eyes quietly followed his back, and added, "I finished the two bottles of extraordinary potion you gave me. I took a test at the institute yesterday, and my energy level reached 1.8 already. "
